title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: missing end-to-end TH_4 assertion in interop test
description:
The EDHOC interop test at edhoc.rs:1651-1659 calls `process_message_2_with_credential` and checks it succeeds, but never asserts `initiator.state.th_4` equals the expected `th_4` test vector (line 1636). This gap allowed the TH_4-plaintext bug to go undetected: the test only validates `transcript_4()` as a standalone function, not the actual code path in `process_message_2_with_credential`.

Add `assert_eq!(verifier.state.th_4, th_4);` after the `verified_message_3.is_ok()` check. Similarly verify `responder.state.th_4` end-to-end on the responder side.
